items.title: Regularity of a Noetherian local ring passes to its henselization and strict henselization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that regularity of a Noetherian local ring is equivalent to regularity of its henselization and of its strict henselization, and the proof is a 19-line argument that compares minimal systems of generators. It first notes that the two henselizations are Noetherian so that the statement makes sense, then chooses a minimal system of generators of the maximal ideal of the base, and uses faithful flatness of the two maps to see that the images stay a minimal system of generators of the extended maximal ideals; regularity is then read off from the equality of dimensions already available for henselizations. The faithful flatness step and the dimension comparison are the two ingredients, and both are displayed.
